_comment: WS-5 DYNAMIC 5-car CONTENTION demo over the convoy_px4 world (the SIM-5 world: ONE gz server, 5 RoboMaster cars ids 7/11/23/42/88, 1 onboard cam per drone @5 Hz -> RTF ~0.86). = the transport wiring of sitl3_vision.json (same 3 endpoints/ports/bands) but the 3 drones run DYNAMIC track_convoy (track_marker_ids null) over a 5-id registry instead of sentry_scan. This is the CONTENTION case the 3-lane demo can't show: 5 known cars, only 3 drones, so the registry must (a) hand each drone a DISTINCT car (single-winner CAS), (b) report remaining_ids = the 2 unclaimed cars, (c) tally serviced as drones finish, and (d) on a drone LOSS (run_vision.sh kill3 -9's charlie's px4) free its car as LOST so a free drone can re-claim it. convoy_ids [7,11,23,42,88] seeds all five; convoy_lock_ttl_s 12 s is the no-renew survival window (Wi-Fi-drop / drone-loss model). NOTE (gate-F): convoy_px4 was authored for sentry SCANNING, so the 3 drones do NOT each spawn over a distinct car — which car each drone first SEES (and thus claims) depends on the SIM-5 spawn poses + how the cars drive. The DEDUP / tally / LOST->re-claim properties hold regardless (they are registry properties, pure-proven in WS-1/2); what needs VM tuning is only WHICH 3 of the 5 get serviced and whether all 3 drones acquire promptly. Tune spawn poses / car routes / lock_ttl on the box. Run via sim/run_vision.sh dyn5 (normal) or kill3-style loss drill.
